loaded_code_evidence: Compare each process start time with the mtime of veteran_desk/book.py and gate_v2.py on its root. A process that started earlier cannot hold the new bytes. There is no in-process hash to query, and this package does not add one.
tick_skip_not_used: The tick script skips when .tick.flock is held. This release does not take that lock, because a skipped tick would delay stops.
rollback: Restore both roots from the sealed original bytes. That does not rewrite the ledger or unload a process that already imported the new file. The long-running engine never imports the new file until a later explicit recycle.
